intro.title: Professional Plumbing Solutions Since 1995
intro.text1: Founded in 1995 by Master Davut, Özinan Yapı Malzemeleri has been providing expert plumbing solutions for over 30 years. Our deep expertise in plumbing repairs and renovations has made us the trusted choice for countless homes in Istanbul.
intro.text2: As Özinan Yapı Malzemeleri, we combine our years of experience with quality plumbing materials and modern techniques. We are experts in bathroom and kitchen repairs, drain cleaning, complete bathroom renovation and emergency plumbing services.
intro.text3: Our expert plumber team led by Master Davut ensures that every job is completed to the highest standards. From a simple faucet repair to a complete bathroom renovation, we offer reliable solutions with quality products sourced from our own materials store.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description: Öz İnan Yapı Malzemeleri privacy policy - Information about how we collect and use your personal data

section1.title: Information Collection and Use
section1.content: As Öz İnan Yapı Malzemeleri, we collect certain personal information to provide you with better service. This information includes your name, phone number, email address, and details about your service request. We use this information solely to provide plumbing services, create appointments, and communicate with you.

section2.title: Information Security
section2.content: The security of your personal information is extremely important to us. We take appropriate security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, modification, or disclosure. Your information is stored on secure servers and is only accessible by authorized personnel.

section3.title: Third-Party Sharing
section3.content: We do not share, sell, or rent your personal information to third parties without your explicit consent. Your information is used solely for service provision and in accordance with legal requirements.

section4.title: Cookies and Tracking
section4.content: Our website may use cookies to improve user experience. Cookies are small files stored in your browser that help us remember your site preferences. You can disable cookies from your browser settings.

section5.title: Your Rights
section5.content: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can contact us for any requests regarding your personal information.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.description: Öz İnan Yapı Malzemeleri terms of service and conditions of use

section1.title: Scope of Services
section1.content: Öz İnan Yapı Malzemeleri provides professional plumbing and heating services on the European side of Istanbul. Our services include drain cleaning, bathroom-kitchen plumbing, boiler maintenance, water leak detection, and emergency plumbing service. All our services are performed by expert personnel.

section2.title: Appointment and Cancellation Policy
section2.content: Appointments are taken via phone, WhatsApp, or through our website. You must cancel your appointment at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations or no-shows may incur a service fee. No advance appointment is required for emergency service calls.

section3.title: Pricing and Payment
section3.content: Service fees are determined based on the scope of work, materials used, and duration. An estimated price is provided before starting the work. Payment can be made in cash or by bank transfer. We issue invoices for all our work. We offer a 1-year warranty on quality materials and craftsmanship.

section4.title: Warranty and Responsibilities
section4.content: We provide a 1-year warranty on all work performed and materials used. Warranty coverage includes workmanship errors and material defects. The warranty does not cover misuse or third-party interventions. In emergency situations, our response time is maximum 2 hours.

section5.title: Right to Modify
section5.content: Öz İnan Yapı Malzemeleri reserves the right to modify the terms of service without prior notice. Current terms are published on our website. By continuing to use our services, you agree to the updated terms.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our plumbing services
faq.question1: How quickly do you respond to emergencies?
faq.answer1: In emergency plumbing situations, we reach your address on the European side of Istanbul within a maximum of 2 hours. In Esenler, Bayrampaşa, Güngören, and surrounding districts, we can respond even faster.
faq.answer2: We serve the entire European side of Istanbul. Our main service areas include: Esenler, Bayrampaşa, Bağcılar, Güngören, Merter, Gaziosmanpaşa, and surrounding districts.
faq.question3: Do you provide warranty for your work?
faq.answer3: Yes, we provide a 1-year warranty on all work performed and materials used. Warranty coverage includes workmanship errors and material defects.
faq.answer4: Before starting work, we conduct an inspection and provide an estimated price. Fees are determined based on the scope of work, materials used, and duration. We have a transparent pricing policy and do not charge surprise fees.
faq.question5: Do I need to make an appointment?
faq.answer5: We recommend making an appointment for regular services. However, in emergencies, we respond immediately without requiring an appointment. You can call us at 0532 453 38 02 or contact us via WhatsApp to make an appointment.
faq.question6: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer6: We accept cash and bank transfer payments. We issue invoices for all our work.
faq.answer7: Yes, since we have our own materials store, we provide all plumbing materials. We only use quality and guaranteed products.
faq.question8: Do you provide service on weekends?
faq.answer8: Yes, we provide service on weekdays and weekends. We are available 24/7 for emergencies. Our working hours: Monday-Saturday 08:30-20:00.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.description: Öz İnan Yapı Malzemeleri cookie usage policy

section1.title: What Are Cookies?
section1.content: Cookies are small text files saved to your device when you visit our website. These files are used to improve your site experience and remember your preferences. Cookies help our website function better and help us understand which pages are most visited.

section2.title: Which Cookies Do We Use?
section2.content: We use essential cookies and analytics cookies on our website. Essential cookies are necessary for the site's basic functions to work. Analytics cookies help us understand site usage and make improvements. We may use third-party cookies (e.g., Google Analytics).

section3.title: How Can You Control Cookies?
section3.content: You can delete or block cookies at any time from your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may cause some features of our website to not function properly. Most browsers are set to accept cookies automatically.

section4.title: Cookie Policy Changes
section4.content: We may update this cookie policy from time to time. Changes will be published on this page. By continuing to use our website, you agree to the updated cookie policy.
